meta.purpose: Greedy cross-check prompts: native runtime vs vLLM on MiniCPM5-2b (bf16)
notes: Multi-turn cases keep assistant history text FIXED so both backends render byte-identical prompts through the same official chat template (assistant history without <think> gets an empty think block injected by the template, identically on both ends).
Categories: zh_knowledge x8, en_knowledge x6, code_gen x6, math x6, translation x4, mixed_zh_en x4, creative x4, commonsense x4, multi_turn_fixed_history x5 => 47 prompts.
Prompts kept from the 9-case pre-experiment (/tmp/opencode/cmp_ours.json) are reused verbatim for continuity.
